soundness_flags.label: prop:exact-whole-set-coverage
soundness_flags.one_line: Once P belongs to the imported multinomial region, containment in the union defining the envelope is a zero-step definition unfold, so it cannot stand as a substantive proposition.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v1, corroborative preprint; cited ISIT proceedings metadata confirmed but primary PDF was inaccessible
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: G(X;Y)=min H(W) over X→W→Y; the paper gives a support-three bound for binary alphabets and then shows a two-state optimizer suffices for its pure binary product-mixture problem.

The paper assumes H(Z)≤θ and derives scalar causal-effect programs whose constraints use mutual information involving canonical response variables or Y_x and X; it does not state a joint benefit--harm identified set.

The paper studies minimum-entropy latents making two observed discrete variables conditionally independent and applies common entropy to graph discovery and constraint-based discovery, not counterfactual benefit--harm identification.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Causal Inference 11 (2023), publisher record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article bounds benefit and harm under unmeasured confounding using separate sensitivity-parameter and proxy methods.
The article reduces discrete causal queries to polynomial programs through canonicalization and generalized principal strata, and develops automated sharp numerical bounds.

source_verification_receipts.version: author-hosted copy of Annals of Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence 28 (2000), 287--313
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives theoretically sharp bounds for probabilities of causation under stated causal assumptions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Remove prop:exact-whole-set-coverage as a numbered result, or replace it with a genuinely nontrivial computational theorem quantifying certified-envelope complexity or excess area beyond the imported multinomial event.
Either downgrade “extends causaloptim” to “is informed by causaloptim,” or add a theorem proving strict inclusion of its linear response-function class in BH-CERT's certified entropy-factor class.

Make the joint-set advance harder to relabel as coordinatewise sensitivity analysis by proving a nonrectangular joint boundary or an observable criterion showing that intersected scalar bounds strictly overcover Theta_kappa(P) on an open full-support class.

recommended_next_step: Revise the definition-level coverage proposition and the unsupported causaloptim-extension framing, then retain the exact joint-set, origin-threshold, and certification questions for Stage 0.
